players.product: AvalonMiner bitcoin mining machines (A15 / A16 series; Avalon A1566HA hydro-cooled)

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release (6-K Exhibit 99.1), comparisons the call did not give: total revenues US$31.9 million versus US$62.7 million in Q1 2026 and US$100.2 million in Q2 2025; products revenue US$13.6 million versus US$42.9 million and US$71.9 million (decreased computing power sold and average selling price as Bitcoin prices fell); mining revenue US$17.7 million versus US$19.1 million and US$28.1 million. Installed non-JV mining computing power of 10.05 EH/s was up 23.3% YoY. Product costs included US$25.3 million of inventory write-down, prepayment write-down and provision for inventory purchase commitments (US$24.5 million in Q1 2026); net loss was US$97.6 million.
